svg.title: Maknae agent task lifecycle
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram of an agent task, each step marked live, unreachable or with the issue that builds it: binding recognition, the sealed tasker token, intake, forge_auth on the agent's notice poll for a stored-token agent, one Reach frame per server observing both sides in the Egress Daemon, the queue, the agent's claim poll, the hand-out, the agentic loop with the tool-call sequence, the credential's storage and re-mint, the heartbeat and the optional add, ask, approval and stop exchanges, then the report, the revoke and the collect.
svg.text: An agent's task: bindings and reach, the pull hand-off, the agentic loop, the outcome and the revoke
maknaed never dials an agent: maknae-agentd polls until a task is queued for it, then works it in the agentic loop. Each tool call is the one a person makes (generated-tool-invocation.svg).
When the agent's forge credential is a stored token, the kernel first asks the agent for it through forge_auth on its notice poll (#746), then sends one Reach frame that works both sides.

Inside the loop, the tasker may add to the task, the agent may ask (#736), a tool call may wait for the tasker's approval (#174), and the tasker may stop it; halting its containers is #481. Each step shows its build state.

«live» built, reachable in production · «unreachable» built, no production caller · «decided» in an ADR, not built · «#N» planned in that issue
GitHub forge token in Vault at <kv_mount>/data/<user_prefix>/<you>/forges/<host>, field token: vault write -wrap-ttl=60s, or maknae forge login <host>. docs/first-provider.md U2.
Only hosts of git forges in the subject's catalog bind. A task carries at most 8 bindings; a binding never changes after sealing.
A binding's server must be a current git forge host; a sub-task's binding must equal one of its parent's.
No credential is carried. At most 8 outstanding per agent. The wait takes no reach permit.
Control frames only. It never renews the claim lease; the heartbeat still does, so a wedged loop lapses.
At <kv_mount>/data/<agent_prefix>/<id>/forges/<host>, field token. The seal binds the nonce.
Only after the full 10 s; a shorter wait gives the reach refusal. Nothing is stored. The CLI offers retry or another agent; for an /add, retry.

The kernel carries the tasker's token sealed and never opens it. Sub-tasks take the tasker side from the parent's reach. Ruled 2026-11-26, not built (#168): the same frame carries the agent's sealed tokens.
Every answer but 200 refuses the task, a 404 included. The tasker's token is used for this read only and never stored.
GET /repos is never called with an installation token: its permissions block reads all false (measured 2026-11-19).
404, or 403 without rate-limit headers: empty, AgentNotCovered. 401, 429, a rate-limited 403, 5xx, a redirect or the deadline refuses.
Ruled 2026-11-26, not built (#168): egress computes the intersection and returns it with both sides.

Queued in the task store; nothing is sent to the agent. GitLab tools stay refused in tasks. github-machine-user's reach is empty today (AtHandOut). Ruled 2026-11-26, not built (#168): observed through forge_auth, in the same Reach frame.
Hand-out re-decides the tasker's role and the agent's taskers:, not the tasker's provider reach (ADR-0037 residual 1).
Live for the file tools and sub-tasks. A tool call in a container is #479: its decision is generated-tool-invocation.svg, its credential and launch generated-tool-credentials.svg.
Produced by the mint in generated-tool-credentials.svg (steps 10 to 13). The task store has no field for it yet. A rotation of egress's seal key strands every outstanding blob (ADR-0038 residual 2).
Ruled 2026-11-26: at each launch, when the remaining life is under the call's timeout plus launch time; the old token is revoked at once.
Sent after a step once HEARTBEAT_EVERY has passed; it renews the 15-minute claim lease. A stop or follow-up is seen here.

Refused once Reported. An /add with new bindings repeats steps 11 to 18 as a signed addendum, delivered on the next heartbeat. Ruled 2026-11-26, not built (#168): steps 5 to 10 first for a stored-token agent.
At the agent's discretion; this is not an interactive session. The question's shape is open in #736.
The tasker may narrow what the site allows, never widen it. Matching and expiry of an approval are open in #174.
The agent never reaches the tasker; the request waits in maknaed until the tasker's session reads it.
The decision never passes through the agent; the kernel still checks it against the site's authorization.
Cooperative today: the agent sees the stop at its next heartbeat, after its in-flight step.
Ruled 2026-11-27, not built (#746): the stop arrives on the notice poll within 5 s, not at the next heartbeat.
Ruled 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27: conditions 1 to 5 end by construction, and if agentd dies the helper stops what it launched; 6, a compromised agent, is cut off by the revoke (step 44).
Ruled 2026-11-26: every close and move to Held, best effort; the kernel caller is wired with #168 PR C. Each gets a trail intent and outcome (ADR-0038 decision 10).
No kernel caller sends this until step 44 is built; an ADR-0038 as-built line follows then. The reach driver's metadata-read token is already revoked live (step 15).
Nothing is pushed: the open session pulls. On opening a session, it first shows what came while you were away.
